saw_lines: Men and women buy jewelry for what it means, often as a gift, then add a second piece in another stone.
So the sale is won in the first line, where the offer and proof need to show before the click.

points: Your site lists a support line, yet 0 of your 30 ads carry any of its numbers, so a cold viewer meets no proof before the click. Put the number on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.
Your site runs 30% off sitewide, but only 2 of 14 ads mention any offer, so most first buyers miss it before the click. Lead three new ads with the 30% off in line one and print it on the creative.

9 of 14 copy ads open on the same “shop jewelry” line, so the same first line keeps reaching the same people. Run two or three new angles against it: build your own bracelet, shop by stone, and 925 sterling silver.
The same copy runs in 9 of 14 ads, so the same opening line keeps reaching the same audience. Keep the body copy and swap the first line and video cut in those nine ads so each one looks new.
